items.source: If the return value is null, the ModelAndViewContainer.setRequestHandled(boolean) flag is set to true to indicate the request was handled directly.
items.translation: 如果返回值为 `null`，则设置ModelAndViewContainer.setRequestHandled(boolean)标志为true，以表示请求已直接处理。

items.source: A ModelAndView return type has a set purpose. Therefore this handler should be configured ahead of handlers that support any return value type annotated with @ModelAttribute or @ResponseBody to ensure they don't take over.
items.translation: `ModelAndView` 返回类型具有特定用途。因此，此处理器应配置在支持任何返回值类型且标注有 `@ModelAttribute` 或 `@ResponseBody` 的处理器之前，以确保它们不会接管处理。

items.source: Note that simply configuring this property will not make a custom redirect prefix work. There must be a custom View that recognizes the prefix as well.
items.translation: 注意，仅配置此属性并不能使自定义重定向前缀生效。必须有一个能够识别该前缀的自定义View。

items.source: Handle the given return value by adding attributes to the model and setting a view or setting the ModelAndViewContainer.setRequestHandled(boolean) flag to true to indicate the response has been handled directly.
items.translation: 处理给定的返回值，通过向模型添加属性并设置视图，或设置ModelAndViewContainer.setRequestHandled(boolean)标志为true，以指示响应已被直接处理。

items.source: Configure one more simple patterns (as described in PatternMatchUtils.simpleMatch(String, String)) to use in order to recognize custom redirect prefixes in addition to "redirect:".
items.translation: 配置更多简单的模式（如PatternMatchUtils.simpleMatch(String, String)中所述），以便除了"redirect:"之外，还能识别自定义的重定向前缀。

items.source: Whether the given method return type is supported by this handler.
items.translation: 给定方法返回类型是否由该处理器支持。

items.source: Return the configured redirect patterns, if any.
items.translation: 返回配置的跳转模式（如果有）。

items.source:
Whether the given view name is a redirect view reference.
The default implementation checks the configured redirect patterns and
also if the view name starts with the "redirect:" prefix.
items.translation: 给定视图名称是否为重定向视图引用。默认实现会检查配置的重定向模式，以及视图名称是否以"redirect:"前缀开头。

items.source: viewName - the view name to check, never null
items.translation: viewName - 要检查的视图名称，绝不可能是 null。

items.source:
"true" if the given view name is recognized as a redirect view
reference; "false" otherwise.
items.translation: 如果给定的视图名称被识别为重定向视图引用，则返回 "true"；否则返回 "false"。
